subject: general
question: There are 20 people in a party. If every person shakes hand with every other person, then what will be the total number of handshakes?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

The total number of persons in a party = 20.

**FORMULA USED:**

Number of handshakes possible with various people saying "n"

can be solved by a formula n times ( n - 1) over 2 

This is because each of the "n" numbers of people can shake hands with " ( n - 1)" people and they will not shake their own hands.

The handshake between two people cannot be counted twice.

**CALCULATION:**

As the total number of people in the party is 20.

⇒ The total number of handshakes when each one of the persons shakes had with other exactly once 

⇒ 20 times ( 20 - 1) over 2 = 20 × 19 /2 = 190.

**Hence, the total number of handshakes is 190.**
